focus: This week's update focused on the IGNIS intelligence engine: when you return to the site, the oracle now shows you what the community has been exploring and cross-references your past queries with new content published since your last visit. Oracle results also get smarter the longer you search — each follow-up query knows what you've been asking about. On the infrastructure side, we added automatic performance regression detection to CI (Lighthouse score drops are now a blocking failure) and pushed notification content now adapts per game.
nextStep: Verifying the Lighthouse performance score crosses the 80% threshold after our recent fix, and sending the first push notification once subscriber count grows.
